title: Down the Road Apiece
overview: A lonely ranch hand in rural West Texas decides to risk the only life he's ever known when he falls for a hard-pressed woman stranded in the nearby town. He makes up his mind to leave with her, but things don't quite work out as planned.

title: Tunes
overview: An aspiring artist, facing failure and self-doubt, strives to create a song that could potentially change his future.

title: Naughty
overview: To secure custody of her son from her ex, Mallory's only hope is to find Santa Claus and convince him to testify in her divorce hearing.

title: Joshua
overview: In development.

title: The Fields of Abbottsville
overview: In Ohio, late 2004, after a young religious fanatic Joshua Tinsman (Brennan Abbott) celebrates his 18th birthday. He is then forced into committing crimes by his preacher Ron Tinsman Jr. (Aaron Hickman) that he doesn't want to follow through on. Years of indoctrination and influence from his friends discourages him from leaving. After all, it's the ideology that he and his childhood friend Stephen grew up with since birth. How can you leave something you spent your whole life working towards? Loosely based on a true story.

title: Star Wars: Starfighter
overview: An original story set approximately five years after the events of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker.

title: Thomas
overview: In development.

title: The Nightingale
overview: The lives of two French sisters are torn apart by the onset of World War II.

title: Get to That Place
overview: A group of kids navigate their lives and interpersonal relationships while a rumor about the end of the world spreads around town.

title: Wraith
overview: A psychological horror in which a man named Mark wanders a dark, deserted hospital looking for his supposedly dead wife, whose spirit continues to call out to him beyond the halls…

title: Logan
overview: In development.

title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
original_title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
overview: Lindsey and her extended family head to Walt Disney World to spend a magical Christmas together, but the dream of a jolly holiday gets quickly dashed when Lindsey discovers her room is next door to Philip, a disastrous first date she recently had, who’s also there on a family trip. As Lindsey and Philip’s paths cross throughout their stay, the frost starts to thaw as they learn they’re not so different from each other after all. Thanks to some Walt Disney World magic, the holiday wish Lindsey made in Cinderella Fountain just might turn their rivalry into romance.

title: Christmas at the Zoo
overview: An entrepreneur brokering a sponsorship to build the city zoo's new penguin habitat finds herself caught between business and romance after falling for a compassionate zookeeper over the holidays.

title: Malvina
overview: Malvina is an angel sent to earth for being ignorant of it's problems. she falls to earth and after an incounter with a grieving mother seeks adamentley the love she talks about. when receiving this love finally she becomes addicted. she is filled with so much love for everyone she eventually loses herself completely in the desires and wants of everyone around her.

title: Dolioo
overview: Sarah Jamson, daughter of Hudson’s murdered ally, wages a one-woman war against Hudson, using stealth, strategy, and vengeance-marked corpses to haunt him psychologically. Chloe Varenne, a symbol of lost love and innocence, becomes the spark that pushes KAEL toward rebellion.

title: Our Share of Sand
overview: After years apart, 12 year-old Maya returns to India with her mother to reunite with her father - a sandmining business man. Immersed in a world where labour, legacy and extraction collide, she forms a fragile bond with Kiran, a young worker. After a tragic event, a police investigation turns Maya into a key witness, with her father relying on her to absolve him. Torn between loyalty and a growing unease she cannot name, Maya begins searching for the truth. As her mother quietly unravels, Maya uncovers a pattern of silence, exploitation and repeated harm forcing her to confront her father's deception and the family's complicity she must choose to break.

title: The Fall of Barsisa
overview: A modern re-imagining of the fable of the same name. Three brothers leave their ailing sister in the company of a devout and honourable figure as they are guided by an ambiguous stranger through treacherous terrain in search of a remedy.

title: The House
overview: A teenager calls his friend over to talk about a reoccurring dream he has about a house.

title: Visitor
overview: In the aftermath of her mother’s death, Nour awaits a visit from her aunt. Nour’s mother used to say that her aunt was a vampire, and as she anticipates her arrival Nour ruminates on her mother’s life and experiences as an Arab immigrant in the American Rust Belt.

title: Buzzkill
overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: The Devil in Me
overview: In a dusty nowhere town of the Nevada desert, a stranded drifter wins an ancient hourglass in a late-night card game, unaware that it carries a violent, soul-hungry curse. As the sand inside begins to fall, the object twists his mind and forces him toward unspeakable acts, feeding on the lives it consumes. With time running out and the line between fate and possession blurring, he must confront the evil now living inside him before the hourglass claims his soul entirely. A folk-horror western about isolation, temptation, and the cost of borrowed time.

title: ORBITER
overview: When the government doesn't act enough, two friends part ways as one is sent on a mission to orbit the earth, while the other has to stay.

title: Lycanthropy
overview: A young woman wanders through a forest with unease, unaware of the violent creature lurking closely behind. This was created for an assignment in an Audio/Visual Productions class.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: Mickey+ Shorts: Mickey + Toy Story
overview: Mickey along with Pixar's Toy Story friends Woody, Buzz, and Jessie celebrates the wonder and joy of play.

title: A Tell Tail Summer
overview: A Doe and a Wolf live in paradise together. One day, a Crow comes along and reveals Wolf's true nature. The first installment in a Four-Part series based on the four seasons.

title: The only girl in the world
overview: Carole, a young, melancholic girl, escapes into her own world of fantasy, where she imagines herself as her opposite: extroverted and passionate. When she falls in love with her new best friend Suzanne, who embodies everything she has ever longed to be, Carole decides to bring her imaginary world to life in her own way.

title: COLECTIVO: The First Year
overview: Go behind the scenes of COLECTIVO's inaugural year, as three emerging Latinx filmmakers receive mentorship from Lin-Manuel Miranda and Tribeca Studios, culminating in a Tribeca Festival premiere. Three bold new voices. One extraordinary fellowship.

title: One Last Shot
overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

title: Isolation
overview: Isolation explores loneliness, grief, loss, and the struggles of mental health. All within a pursuit of understanding one's purpose. It's a coalescence of one's trauma and working through it while performing at a high level.

title: Soul Conversation
overview: Centred around girlhood, grief and the ideology that today is impactful whether you notice it or not. Following Alana as she struggles with the day to day life of a girl in her early adulthood, while still grieving the loss of her mother.

title: Black Wine
overview: Black Wine

title: Truth Or Dare
overview: At a seemingly normal sleepover with 5 friends, one question ends the night in horror

title: Big Fish The Movie
overview: This romantic comedy follows a young man's newfound interest in the Belfast Salmon of Knowledge. When his roommates discover this new obsession, a series of dramatic events unfolds.  Will this love stand the test of time?

title: Women of Dominica
overview: An intergenerational story of ten women on the Caribbean island of Dominica, interwoven through mentorship, matriarchal wisdom, and ancestral heritage. Bound by the love for their island, the film honors their resilience, identity, and cultural legacy.

title: Khamenei's Last Move
overview: For thirty-six vears, Ali Khamenei prepared Iran for a confrontation he believed would eventually come.  This documentary traces the doctrine he built, the forces that challenged it, and the war that ultimately reached his own home.  He could have moved. He didn't  Did Khamenei simply accept the risk--or did he understand what his death could set in motion?

title: Murder, She Toked
overview: Best buds Hannah and Mel investigate a mysterious murder at the anniversary party of a Hip-Hop mogul's weed lounge.

title: The Haunting Of Play House
overview: It's a long story. Well, not that long, the playhouse is haunted.

title: Memorias del Silencio
overview: A young woman travels to La Palma following the death of a distant grandfather, only to discover—in a hidden letter—the love he never knew how to express.

title: Premature
overview: After an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, two flatmates must confront who they are, and who they want to be, before the baby arrives.

title: CHASING RAHUL
overview: In modern-day Bangalore, Sama sets on to chase the old-school romance she grew up believing in, all while discovering the little beauties of Bangalore city.

title: The Depths
overview: After a brother and sister achieve astral projection, the footage they capture reveals the malicious effects of their family trauma.

title: Godmother
overview: A meticulously planned desert couples' vacation spirals into chaos when family tensions and a pair of mysterious hosts with devilish intentions transform a romantic getaway into a nightmare.

title: FLAPJAX
overview: An over-eager fast-food manager is tasked with reviving a highly addictive menu item called "FLAPJAX" to save his fast-food company from bankruptcy. He pulls his estranged mother, a faded pop-star known as Popo, out of retirement to promote the item. However, he soon becomes ensnared by the company's true intentions and his deeply rooted mommy issues.

title: Espresso Martini
overview: When Jensen’s freshly formed frontal lobe develops an insatiable thirst for pure, unadulterated grind-force, he has to learn how to mix things up and sip more slowly.

title: Odysseus: The Fall
overview: Odysseus left Troy with twelve ships and six hundred men. None of them saw home again. In Homer, the famous sea-stories, the Cyclops, the witch, the Sirens, are told by one voice: his own, to a court of strangers, with no survivor left to contradict him. ODYSSEUS: The Fall retells the epic as the fractured memory of a drowning man, the same voyage, told by the only witness there ever was.

title: Keeh Nuvanee?
overview: A new-age drama exploring relationships, past connections, and personal growth.

title: Visiting Uncle Paul
overview: A short documentary on Brother Paul McMullen, and his life as a Franciscan Brother in Loretto, PA.

title: Betty
overview: A young woman is haunted by the dead lady in her tub.

title: Chicken Scratch
overview: A gambling addict on the eve of eviction in NYC must embark on a wealthy stranger's quest to retrieve a plate of legendary chicken wings in exchange for his rent money.

title: Still Night, Burning House
overview: In her deeply personal debut feature, award-winning filmmaker Carol Nguyen charts her family’s first reunion since her uncle’s mysterious death. Travelling together to Vietnam, the family embarks on a revelatory—and at times uncanny—journey through intergenerational trauma and many-layered loss. With care and probing curiosity, Nguyen guides her loved ones as they navigate unsealed medical records and a decades-long silence, ultimately leading them back to each other. A metaphysical poem for complex mourning, Still Night, Burning House shows how storytelling can transform grief into collective healing.

title: In Alaska
overview: After accidentally shooting at the TransAlaska Pipeline, Woody, a 17-year old Inuit, becomes the target of a terrorist manhunt. The chase through wilderness is led by veteran FBI agent Susan Tarheel, torn between doing her job and her empathy for the young man…

title: Zoners
overview: A desperate young woman is forced to drive a mercenary and a stolen alien device through a land infested with monsters.

title: Drive Through Fire
overview: The story follows an addict war veteran turned rideshare driver who helps a terrified passenger escape a human trafficking ring serving wealthy clients.

title: The Next Shift
overview: In efforts to try and fit in with his new classmates, Wesley decides to join a couple of them on a night out that leads to a crime that may change the course of his life.

title: The Fix
overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: Lachosky
overview: Trapped in a suffocating, abusive marriage within an aseptic futuristic society, Rebecca Bergman lives drowned in profound melancholy, closely surveilled by an oppressive husband who reduces her to complete invisibility. Amid the emotional isolation and constant psychological control of Mr. Bergman, Rebecca finds an unexpected sanctuary in the family’s domestic android, Lachosky, a silent presence whose programmed attentiveness gradually offers her the warmth she has been starved of, transforming the machine into her only refuge for affection and igniting a perilous desire to break free from her gilded cage.

title: McTooey: The Gleebening
overview: Charles McTooey rises from the grave with one goal. Revenge.

title: The Host Unknown
overview: A young man watches a zoom call between friends until things start to take a turn. Made as a part of 48 hour film fest.

title: A Double Entendre
overview: After inheriting a fortune following his parents' deaths, Dominic is taken hostage by an identical stranger who demands he kill himself so the stranger can steal his life.

title: Lobster Film
overview: Two lobsters discuss their lives and relationship.

title: Of Men and Monsters
overview: In a lawless world, what separates good from evil? Through the echoes of his memories, a retired outlaw embarks on one final journey to settle the scores of his past.

title: The Pervert's Guide to Utopias
overview: Philosopher Slavoj Žižek is our guide through landscapes of classic film, music, social media, archive and webcasts. Making unexpected twists and turns, he maps the utopian illusions of our times. Through absurd juxtapositions and startling insights, we are seduced into recognising our fate, in order to change it.

title: The Club That Conquered the Premier League
original_title: The Club That Conquered the Premier League
overview: The story of the local neighbourhood club, Antiguoko, that became a Basque dream team and helped produce Premier League managers Xabi Alonso, Mikel Arteta and Andoni Iraola.

title: Moonfish
overview: A grieving astronaut who's lost his only companion on a deep-space mining mission must fulfill a strict corporate quota to return home. As his year of solitude passes, his grip on reality unravels the line between the living and non-living.

title: How To: Cologne
overview: A simple how to properly apply a cologne to yourself efficiently.

title: Invisible Injuries
overview: After war, Australian veteran Andy Fermo returned home carrying invisible wounds. Invisible Injuries explores PTSD's impact on identity, family and daily life, and the courage it takes to heal, reconnect and keep moving forward.

title: Kappa-Tiran
overview: A controversial thriller set within the shadowy, insular, and institutionally shielded world of fraternities and sororities and its banned tradition of hazing.

title: East of Western
overview: When JC’s ill-fated plan to own land with the help of a violent crime lord goes wrong, his brother Nick is faced with the ultimate life-or-death choice: to save the lives of his wife and daughter, he has to kill his brother.

title: Bench: Body of Work
overview: Follows the return of the iconic Bench Body fashion show after 8 years. Featuring the testimonies from the creatives, confidantes and the visionary himself, the film spotlights the multiple dimensions of The Bench Brand.

title: Zero Intention of Living Quietly
overview: Mistreated by people unable to cope with his unique visible difference, actor Adam Pearson glimpses a path away from isolation through his love of cinema. Upon meeting kindred spirit Ellie - a girl who shares his genetic condition, NF1 - their quest begins to forge a new type of movie hero, and finally press play on life.

title: My Fuckass Roommate
overview: An accountant must come to terms with his best friend's new roommate, The Devil.

title: Paper Plane
overview: When a defiant young girl stages a silent protest, refusing to return home until the disruptive presence of her father is gone, her mother must decide whether to follow her or let her go.

title: The Blue Sea
overview: A fisherman has the impression that he is rotting from the inside, like one of his teeth that is bothering him. Lost in the maze of his painful memories, frustrated by the sense of disorder that surrounds him, he is helpless in the face of the spectacle of the repressed demonstrators he sees every day on television. His depression causes his body to melt in an abstract way and to disperse in trails of droplets, in the manner of Francis Bacon's portraits.

title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban
original_title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban
overview: Home alone on the eve of her First Communion, 12-year-old Carmen receives an unexpected visit from a trio of neighborhood roller girls and scooter boys. While at her home, the kids make Carmen painfully aware of her religious upbringing, ultimately stealing her First Communion dress, culminating in a final showdown at their local roller rink.

title: Hauntshow
overview: The twisted final broadcast of an underground variety show. A mysterious, macabre, deviant and delinquent double-bill of chillers hosted by Hauntrella, Hauntressa and the dearly departed Hauntiana.

title: Erased
overview: When confronted by the now 18-year-old son he dismissed before birth, a high-powered businessman must decide between their potential relationship and a life changing financial opportunity.

title: Fork in the Road
overview: Fork in the Road is an intimate documentary that explores the profound connections between people, the land, and the future of our food system. Through a tapestry of compelling stories from independent small-scale farmers across the United States, from Alaskan kelp harvesters to dairy farmers in Kentucky, the film reveals the authentic, lived realities and unprecedented challenges of those working against the tide of escalating industrialization in agriculture. Featuring insights from visionary chefs and culinary experts, Fork in the Road expands the conversation beyond the farm, demonstrating how food sustainability is a shared responsibility that extends into our kitchens and communities. More than a call to environmental action, the film illuminates the vital ways that sustainable food practices can nourish our bodies, strengthen our communities, and heal the Earth.

title: Blood is Thicker
overview: A Texas town is being terrorized by a corrupt sheriff and drug dealing white supremacists. A former resident returns after inheriting some land and becomes embroiled in the corruption when he reconnects with an old high school girlfriend.

title: 808s & BAD DECISIONS: THE STORY OF THE HOLDR
original_title: 808s & BAD DECISIONS: THE STORY OF THE HOLDR
overview: We follow Tallan Macdonald as he becomes “the Worst Underground Rage Rapper” in the world, through a series of interviews backed by friends, and footage of inspirations. The core message of the documentary will be to pursue whatever brings you the most joy, whether it may disturb or annoy others. The tone of the documentary is comedic, but will still include dramatic sections, and themes of coming of age.

title: Where Beauty Hides
overview: A former TV anchor tracks down a reclusive romance novelist hiding a facial deformity. As she uncovers his past, their growing closeness forces him to face the possibility of intimacy after years in isolation.

title: Dead Janitors Club
overview: Dead Janitors Club is a dark comedy crime film adapted from Jeff Klima's real-life memoir, The Dead Janitors Club: Pathetically True Tales of a Crime Scene Cleanup King. The story follows crooked cop Dirk (Jake Busey) and his cash-strapped partner Jeff Klima (Felix Merback) as they run a risky, illicit side-hustle cleaning up crime scenes. Things spiral violently out of control when Jeff lifts a mysterious safe from a bloody crime scene, not realizing it belongs to a dangerous drug cartel. At the same time, Jeff falls for Kerry (Brianna Gage), a tattoo artist who is quickly dragged into the crosshairs.

title: wabi_
overview: Trapped in his nostalgia and haunted by the impermanence of things, a sad little ghost is unable to pass through the liminal space he occupies.

title: Lengwìa
overview: After an agonizing school year bruises his relationship with his well-liked older brother Jonah, socially awkward Teddy meets Cole, a disarming boy, by chance on the street. As their friendship deepens, actions begin to speak louder than words, unraveling the fragile balance between brotherhood, belonging, and yearning during a blistering summer break.

title: Wildcards
overview: A jury deliberating the case of Theodore Sterling, a privileged young man accused of sexual assault of a 20-something African-American woman. The prosecution is led by Assistant State Attorney James Jones, an overworked yet determined prosecutor, who faces off against Greg Sims, a veteran defense attorney with an unbroken 25-year winning streak.

title: Blood Secret
overview: From Cameron Francis, director of last year’s FrightFest acclaimed breakout hit, COVER. Secrets... Lies... Bodies... Nothing stays buried forever. While visiting her best friend, a woman starts to question reality when she's confronted by seemingly supernatural events. As her sanity unravels, she comes to the terrifying realization that she might not survive the night. Set in one location, but given an epic look in John Carpenter-inspired wide-screen, claustrophobia, both mentally and physically, is the overwhelming mood of Francis’ latest miniature gem exploring the universal themes of regret, remorse and ultimately searching for forgiveness.

title: Weedkiller
overview: Weedkiller is a Welsh B-movie and indie SOV horror feature written and directed by filmmaker Tom Hughes. The film follows a humble gardener who goes on a violent rampage to rescue his beloved plants after a gang hijacks his allotment. The movie, described as a genre banger packed with chaos and attitude, draws inspiration from campy classics like The Toxic Avenger.

title: Nervous
overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

title: American Martyr: The Stanley Rother Story
original_title: American Martyr: The Stanley Rother Story
overview: After struggling with his studies in the seminary, a young priest from Oklahoma discerns his call to serve Guatemala’s native people, no matter the cost. Hosted by Fr. Charles Connor.

title: Domeownation
overview: A cat performs a satanic ritual to dominate the world.

title: Overlooked
overview: Overlooked follows Matt Iman as he returns home from a two-year LDS mission and begins navigating adulthood while living with Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH), a rare genetic condition that leaves his body unable to produce cortisol. Though he appears healthy, every day is shaped by medication, emergency preparedness, and the constant risk of a life threatening adrenal crisis. Through intimate observational storytelling, the film offers a deeply personal look at life with an invisible illness while exploring resilience, family, and the invisible realities of living with a rare disease.

title: Anchorage Point
overview: World renown architect struggles with the weight of his failed bridge design and the lives it claimed

title: God I Want You
overview: After his ex-girlfriend gets engaged, a man struggles to see God’s plan for his life. He looks for answers in another lost soul.

title: Summer's Sunsong
overview: Following the method of interpolation from Towards the Night, Summer's Sunsong is divided into two halves, the first involving shots in Spain (Mallorca) via my phone, the second involving shots of Turkey (Bodrum) shot via an old camcorder, with the interpolation of these two being the basis of the themes presented here.

title: Killer Chickens
overview: Detective Thomas Mitchell is sent to solve a murder case, but the only suspect is his Chickens

title: The Babysitter’s Double Life
overview: A College Student begins an affair with a wealthy man who inspires her to create a babysitting-adjacent service for lonely, divorced fathers. However, things soon get dangerous as the operation grows into a full prostitution ring under her name.

title: Anton Chekhov's The Student
overview: Returning through the bitter cold from a failed Good Friday hunt, a disillusioned theology student recounts Peter’s biblical denial to two widows by a fire, revealing an unbroken chain of beauty and human suffering.

title: A Trip Towards the Temenos
overview: A feature film that captures a travel into the village of Lyssarea for the Temenos, the inaugural screenings of Gregory J. Markopoulos's Eniaios (2004-2026). From Athens to the region of Arcadia, a film about friend's wanderings, the quietness of nature and an observation of the movement of light in Greece and the Peloponnese.

title: No One in the Woods
overview: When a man disappears into a remote forest after a frantic chase, a local resident begins to feel a strange attraction to the place. Amidst visions, moments of silence and unsettling apparitions, the line between reality and his own mind becomes increasingly blurred.

title: A Mother's Secret
overview: When a body is found in the walls of her dream home during renovation, new mother, Kenzie Carter spirals into paranoia experiencing terrifying visions about her daughter, Anna. Kenzie’s worried but busy husband, Eric, suggests a nanny to help. Enter Genevieve, the mysterious nanny who bonds instantly with Anna. As Kenzie’s grip on reality fractures, the body is identified revealing dark history, a missing past, and a deadly secret that threatens everyone Kenzie loves.

title: Living On: The Michael Cammarata Story
original_title: Living On: The Michael Cammarata Story
overview: Since 1947, the Little League World Series has had more than 11,000 players take the field. Only one has ever had their number retired.

title: All the Mayor's Men
overview: The rise and fall of a drifter who declares himself mayor of a ghost town inhabited solely by mannequins.

title: Yesterday's Summer Blues
overview: As Summer draws to a close, two friends enjoy their last days together before parting in different directions.

title: Lesbian Ditch Day
overview: Lesbian Ditch Day starts as a rom-com-y, coming-of-age tale of two high school lesbians playing hooky, but through a fourth wall break, the film reveals itself to be just another queerbaiting tragedy.

title: South of Seattle
overview: Jane visits an old friend.

title: Garchaster's Cornblade
overview: A gricky star planet girl follows a casting call into the Earth oven so she can fulfill her dream of getting inside of a VHS tape... to burn and inhale herself. Donald Farmer weaves golden webs with the cryogenic cowboys while the star planet gets heavier with razzling trash carnivals. The Carpet Muckers twirling gorches but the Garbites are way too hungry for karaoke flavored peanut butter screams.
